# Menu Check

> Restaurant menus in the United States with prices in USD, starting with the MICHELIN-starred restaurants. Every page states where the menu came from (the restaurant's own website, PDF, e-menu, or a menu photographed in the restaurant) and the date it was checked.

## Data and search

- [menus.json](https://alpha-0619.github.io/usa-menus/menus.json): every dish and set-menu line with its price (USD), the menu's source URL and the date we checked it, one JSON file for all restaurants.
- [Search](https://alpha-0619.github.io/usa-menus/search/?q=duck&max=120): find restaurants by dish or ingredient (French or English) and price; URL parameters q (words), city, stars (1, 2, 3 or bib) and max (highest price).
